text: President Trump is actually reducing prescription drug prices.
zh: 白宫：特朗普总统正在切实降低处方药价格。

text: Expanding collaboration with ElevenLabs; Nemotron models now in ElevenAgents
zh: 英伟达：扩大与 ElevenLabs 合作，Nemotron 模型接入 ElevenAgents，为全球企业和政府提供语音智能体。

text: Starship Super Heavy rocket booster moved to launch pad
zh: 马斯克：星舰超重型助推器已移至发射台。

text: Gemini Decisions API
zh: 皮查伊：推出 Gemini Decisions API（Gemini Decision 1 模型，Google AI Studio），面向封闭式选择题，一次可对最多1000个跨文本、图像、音视频和PDF的问题打分。

text: Tesla self-driving now approved in Finland
zh: 马斯克：特斯拉自动驾驶已在芬兰获批。

text: In order to work through more of the Cybertruck order backlog, production will be extended through the end of summer 2027
zh: 马斯克：为消化更多 Cybertruck 积压订单，生产将延长至2027年夏末。

text: @SecScottBessent delivered keynote remarks at the National Committee on United States-China Relations gala. "Trade must advance the interests of both parties without diminishing the sovereignty of either..."
zh: 美国财政部：贝森特在美中关系全国委员会晚宴发表主旨演讲称，贸易必须促进双方利益、且不损害任何一方主权，特朗普总统正是本着这一精神处理对华贸易。

text: SpaceX has ordered 100 GW/year of HJT solar manufacturing equipment from Singulus in Germany. This is for Starmind to create a sentient sun.
zh: 马斯克：SpaceX已向德国Singulus订购每年100吉瓦的HJT太阳能电池制造设备，用于Starmind卫星。

text: For 47 years, Iran has killed innocent people... President Trump had the courage to take on the Iranian threat with full force.
zh: 白宫：47年来伊朗杀害无辜民众、抗议者和美国人，并通过圣战恐怖主义对西方开战；特朗普总统有勇气全力应对伊朗威胁。

text: Speech by Vice Chair for Supervision Bowman on the U.S. economy and considerations for monetary policy
zh: 美联储：负责监管的副主席鲍曼就美国经济与货币政策考量发表讲话。

text: A new statement from the independent members of the NVIDIA Board
zh: 英伟达新闻室：英伟达董事会独立董事发布新声明。

text: We have signed a major supply contract with SINGULUS ... 100 GW of equipment ... Starmind satellites in Bastrop, Texas
zh: SpaceX：与SINGULUS签下大额供货合同，支持超100吉瓦的先进太阳能电池制造设备，加速德州Bastrop的Starmind卫星生产。

text: Yet another historic investment for American manufacturing. President Trump is prioritizing MADE IN AMERICA.
zh: 白宫：美国制造业再获一笔历史性投资，特朗普总统优先推动“美国制造”，带来更多就业、投资和财富。

text: Super Heavy moved to the launch pad at Starbase. Booster 22 ...
zh: SpaceX：超重型助推器22号（首个计划返回发射场被捕获的V3助推器）已运抵星港发射台，完成捕获高度挤压测试。

text: Now in beta: Businesses in ChatGPT.
zh: OpenAI：ChatGPT「商家」功能开启测试，企业可认领资料、查看互动数据，并构建商业智能体回答客户问题。

text: NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge is here
zh: 英伟达：Alpamayo 2 Edge发布，为车端带来实时自适应AI推理，开发者可基于该开源模型开发。

text: Gemini 4 Carbon is rolling out today.
zh: 皮查伊：Gemini 4 Carbon今日开始推送，面向长时程任务，擅长复杂软件工程、网络安全和科学发现，通过Gemini API等提供。

text: Anthropic has launched the roadshow for its proposed IPO
zh: Anthropic：已启动拟议首次公开募股（IPO）的路演。

text: Turns out that the Starlink software, built for managing the movement of vast amounts of data through space and to the ground, is also very well suited to training super intelligence
zh: 马斯克：星链软件原本用来管理太空与地面之间的海量数据传输,结果也非常适合用来训练超级智能。

text: Speech by Governor Waller on the economic outlook @KingsCollegeLon. Watch live.
zh: 美联储：沃勒理事在伦敦国王学院就经济前景发表演讲(正在直播)。

text: Grok — quoting @SpaceX VP of Launch: Grok is now helping identify foreign object debris in aerospace parts; Grok (99.9%) is better at it than humans (94%).
zh: 马斯克：转发SpaceX发射副总裁的说法——Grok已用于识别航天零件中的异物碎片，准确率99.9%，高于人工的94%。
